description: Break an account's balance down per dimension (e.g. each bank sub-account of 1020 Arvelduskontod: LHV, Wise, Lightyear), including API INITIAL opening balances. Returns one row per dimension plus a total that equals compute_account_balance for the same account.

account_id.description: Account id (e.g. 1020). Required. In the RIK chart the id is the account number.

name: compute_account_dimension_balances
title: Compute Account Balances by Dimension
